rater: Codex assistant; not independent human annotation
procedure: Caption names A/B masked; model mapping not read during judgement. Images reviewed before final val metrics. References not displayed on boards. Not a new numeric gate.

rows.notes: B correctly places the new cream bowl on right, pastry plate lower-left and pastries on existing blue plate. A invents/misplaces a blue plate/white bowl at upper-left; plate there already existed.

Both identify bird orientation changes but call yellow/green bird teal. A better captures black/red bird facing away; B better captures left bird facing away, while B front-left gaze for black/red bird is unsupported. Neither uniformly better.

Brightness increase and bird moving toward left of stump are visible and captured by A. B before-facing-left claim is unsupported (beak already points right); seed quantity change is uncertain under lighting. A more grounded main change.

Global camera viewpoint/roll changes while shoe layout is largely preserved. Both captions invent shoe movement; B additionally asserts disappearances despite visible black/red shoes. Neither captures the main camera nuisance correctly; both factually poor.

After image clearly shows backbend,one supporting hand on ground and other near head. B captures backward waist/head bend; A incorrectly describes both hands touching ground and gaze down. Limb left/right details in both remain uncertain.
Both retain crossed-arms to eye-massage with hands/thumbs at inner eye corners. A adds visible downward head tilt; B specifies thumbs. Main event accurate in both, no material factual winner.
Both capture black bird replaced by blue/white bird. A wrongly says new bird faces left; visible beak points right/down. B left-stump placement and downward head direction better supported.
Near-equivalent wording about brighter lighting/head tilt/ears. Both omit obvious change in dog distance/position and mouth opening. No material advantage between captions.

Both mix correct additions with errors. A correctly treats pastries on existing blue plate as added but wrongly says pastry plate moved and places red cup right of white plate. B correctly captures pastry addition/cup upper-center but invents a newly appeared plate with cakes at upper-right. No clean overall winner.

Both capture floor-supported inverted pose to one hand on ball/other up, but contain anatomy errors. B adds clearly unsupported90-degree right knee/foot touching ball in after image; foot is on floor. A closer on overall after orientation,though W-shaped/bent-leg wording also inaccurate.

Clock change and microphone movement captured by both. One nearer gray/dark mouse really disappears; A includes this event while B omits it. A mouse colour is imprecise and farther black mouse remains,so not treating every descriptor as exact.

A better contrasts roughly horizontal arm balance with raised/inverted after pose and changed legs. B repeatedly claims a foot touches ground although visible feet are elevated. A also has incorrect straight-arm/head-up details; neither is fully accurate.
Both capture panda becoming upright and holding bamboo. Different extra before-pose detail is plausible; exact two-hand bamboo claims are partly occluded. No material visual winner.

Both describe the new eye-massage gesture plausibly. A explicitly contrasts crossed arms with fingertips at eyes; B mostly describes after pose but adds head tilt. Neither has a clear material factual error; head/body side rotation omitted by both.

Yellow/black bird moves lower and becomes partly occluded by food/branches. Both horizontal-direction/head claims are doubtful; hidden head and small background birds prevent reliable material preference from these frames.
Equivalent dimming statements, both miss the clear wider framing/zoom-out. Lighting change alone is uncertain under changed framing; no material difference between captions.

Both capture dimming and bamboo eating/head movement. B adds closed-eyes/two-hand manipulation details not reliably visible; A simpler but head-direction wording also ambiguous. Cannot establish material winner from occluded hands/eyes.

Inspected full-resolution pair rotated upright. B captures new foreground black chair and removal of tan chair near wall; old black chair shifts back/right. A captures some movement but invents open umbrella on chair back (new umbrella is closed/on floor) and omits clear chair add/remove events. Both incomplete; B more grounded.

Many errors in both. A correctly includes black-cake plate upper-left and new pink plate below center; B wrongly says existing brown-rim plate was replaced by pink and mixes up plate contents. A also wrongly moves brown-rim plate and claims cookies in cream bowl; preference is partial,not full correctness.

After image shows index fingertips moved from inner eye corners to under-eye/outer-cheek region. A captures this. B wrongly places index fingers between eyebrows and confuses the contacting fingers with thumbs.

preference_rule: Prefer a caption only for material factual accuracy/coverage difference; paraphrase and minor extra correct detail can be similar. Mark uncertain where image evidence is inadequate. Neither caption need be fully correct.
